releaseName: Lokify v1.4.8 – Single Prompt Google Sign-In & Direct Package Installation
releaseNotes:
• Single Prompt Google Sign-In: Asks only ONCE when clicking continue with Google, using Android's native account chooser without duplicate prompts.
• Direct Package Installation: Configured package visibility, internal cache FileProvider, and direct PackageInstaller intents for seamless updating.
• Removed Guest Citizen Mode: Dedicated authentication for citizens and municipal ward officers.
• Released as Lokify.apk: Official release artifact packaged as Lokify.apk.
